headline: Ground delay programs are holding flights into Newark and San Francisco.

items.text: The FAA has a ground delay program for flights into Newark until 11:59 PM ET because of low clouds. Flights are held at their departure airports, averaging 62 minutes of delay and up to 140 minutes.

The FAA has a ground delay program for flights into San Francisco until 11:59 PM PT because of low clouds. Flights are held at their departure airports, averaging 48 minutes of delay and up to 120 minutes.
The other hubs are running normally: on-time departures (within 30 minutes of schedule) are at 85% or better at every hub reporting so far today.

traveler_note.text: If you are flying to Newark or San Francisco, check your flight status before leaving for the airport, since flights into either may be held at their departure airport.
